title: Desert Tech and Card Arena button art
summary: New interface art appears for the Desert Tech screen and the Card Arena, and three sprite atlases are repacked to hold it. No Palmon, skill, item or text data changed.
highlights: New Desert Tech buttons: Desert_btn_good01 and good02, Desert_btn_icon_good, Desert_btn_icon_time, Desert_btn_plan_01 and the two category buttons.
New Desert Tech panels: Desert_btn_frame_goodnumber, Desert_frame_tipsbg and Desert_image_sharereward.
New Card Arena art: main_btn_battleReport_01, main_btn_battleReport_02 and arena_pic_cup.
The A_UIDesertTech, A_UICardArena and A_UINumberBattle atlases are repacked to fit the new sprites.
